acs.text: A signed-in customer adds a product to favourites with POST /favorites; the API responds 201 with the favourite (its id and the product id).
outcomes: the response is the favourite, with its id
the response contains the product id that was added

acs.text: Adding a product that is already a favourite is rejected and the list still contains it once.
outcomes: adding the same product again with POST /favorites → 409 (story.md#L34, G1)

acs.text: GET /favorites lists the customer's own favourites only; another customer's favourites are never included.
outcomes: GET /favorites lists the customer's own favourites
GET /favorites includes no favourite of another customer

acs.text: Every favourites endpoint responds 401 without a valid token.
outcomes: POST /favorites, GET /favorites and DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} each called with no token → 401
POST /favorites, GET /favorites and DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} each called with an invalid token → 401

acs.text: On the web shop, a signed-in customer who clicks "Add to favourites" on a product page sees "Product added to your favorites list." and the product then appears on the "Favorites" page of their account.
outcomes: after clicking "Add to favourites", the message "Product added to your favorites list." is shown
the product appears on the "Favorites" page of the customer's account

acs.text: DELETE /favorites/{favoriteId} removes the favourite (204) and it no longer appears in GET /favorites.
outcomes: the favourite no longer appears in GET /favorites

rules.text: A product is a customer's favourite at most once: a duplicate favourite is rejected, and the API answers 409 Conflict (not 422 as in the technical notes).
A customer's list of favourite products is personal.

errorModel.case: adding a product that is already a favourite (duplicate favourite), through the API (status resolved by G1)
any favourites endpoint called without a valid token
